mentions.name: ml-by-hand
mentions.description: A deep learning library built from numpy primitives that supports LLM post-training techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with GRPO. It is developed from scratch without high-level abstractions as a learning exercise, building the wheel and then using that wheel to build the car.
